div.head: Hn Prooem 1
div.ab: Hec sunt denique beata pacis ac libertatis exoptate gaudia, quibus toti regno suo gloriosus Cesar Henricus in diuinis legibus et secularibus institutis, scriptis et bonorum operum exhibicionibus irradiat moderatus, prudens, iustus, fortis.
div.note: repeats Quadr II Praef. the work's prooemium, which repeated the last clause of the preface to Quadripartitus Book II
New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 547 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
